# Intact Walking

[Project home](../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

60-second intact forward simulation, raw states and experimental comparisons.

`Simulation_Results/Intact_Walking`

| File or folder | Purpose and units |
| --- | --- |
| [Body_Motion](Body_Motion/README.md) | Predicted body centres and paw positions in world coordinates, metres. |
| [Experimental_References_Used](Experimental_References_Used/README.md) | Exact reference tables used for comparison with the saved simulation. |
| [Ground_Reaction_Forces](Ground_Reaction_Forces/README.md) | Paw forces in newtons. Fx is anterior–posterior (negative braking, positive propulsion), Fy is lateral and Fz is vertical. Reference forces are comparison targets; simulated forces are calculated from paw contact. |
| [Joint_Kinematics](Joint_Kinematics/README.md) | Joint-angle and motion tables. Reference tables describe the comparison target; result tables contain predicted motion. Each filename or column specifies whether angles are in radians or degrees. |
| [Model_Parameters_Used](Model_Parameters_Used/README.md) | Exact physical parameters and excitation used for this saved simulation. |
| [Moment_Arms](Moment_Arms/README.md) | Signed muscle moment arms in metres for rotational coordinates. |
| [Muscle_Activation](Muscle_Activation/README.md) | Computed muscle activation a(t), dimensionless, after activation dynamics. |
| [Muscle_Excitation](Muscle_Excitation/README.md) | Prescribed muscle excitation u(t), dimensionless, before activation dynamics. |
| [Muscle_Forces](Muscle_Forces/README.md) | Computed muscle–tendon tension and passive-fiber contribution in newtons. |
| [Muscle_Joint_Moments](Muscle_Joint_Moments/README.md) | Muscle generalized forces: N m for rotational and N for translational coordinates. |
| [Muscle_Tendon_States](Muscle_Tendon_States/README.md) | Fiber, MTU and tendon lengths (m), fiber velocity (m/s), normalized fiber length and tendon strain. |
| [Simulation_Code_Used](Simulation_Code_Used/README.md) | Implementation recorded with this saved numerical calculation. |

| [ATTACHMENT_MAP.json](ATTACHMENT_MAP.json) | Machine-readable muscle attachment and routing coordinates corresponding to the anatomical map. |
